question: Who launched the SAMRIDDHI (Strengthening and Augmentation of Municipal Revenue for Infrastructure Development) scheme in October 2022 for Delhi, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SAMRIDDHI scheme** was launched in** October 2022** for** Delhi, India.**
 
• The scheme aims to** strengthen and augment municipal revenue **for infrastructure development in the city.
 
• The** Lieutenant Governor of Delhi, Anil Baijal,** launched this scheme.
 
• The scheme is expected to help the **Municipal Corporations of Delhi (MCD) **to generate** more revenue and improve** the infrastructure of the city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Minister of Delhi:**

 
 
• The Chief Minister of Delhi is the** head of the government **of the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
 
• However, the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi is the **administrator of Delhi **and has the power to launch schemes and initiatives related to the development of the city.
 
 
 
• **President of India:**
 
 
• The President of India is the head of state and has a **ceremonial role**.
 
• However, the President does** not** have the power to **launch schemes or initiatives** related to the development of a city.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister of India:**
 
 
• The Prime Minister of India is the **head of the government of India **and has the power to launch national schemes and initiatives.
 
• However, the SAMRIDDHI scheme is specific to** Delhi **and is launched by the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.
